mapper.select: SELECT rr.*, r.visibility AS resource_visibility, r.owner_id AS resource_owner_id, COALESCE(r.title, rr.resource_title) AS resource_title FROM resource_report rr LEFT JOIN resource r ON rr.resource_id = r.id WHERE rr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource_report(resource_id, user_id, reason, status, review_reply, cancelled, resource_title, created_at, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{userId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{reviewReply}, #{cancelled}, #{resourceTitle}, NOW(), #{reviewedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT rr.*, r.visibility AS resource_visibility, r.owner_id AS resource_owner_id, COALESCE(r.title, rr.resource_title) AS resource_title FROM resource_report rr LEFT JOIN resource r ON rr.resource_id = r.id WHERE rr.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC
